module mg_01806(input [11:0] cadr_i,output cvalid_o,output [63:0] cdat_o,input [63:0] cdat_i,input coe_i,input cwe_i,input clk_i);
wire csrv_output = (cadr_i == 12'h0FF);

  $display("%c", charByte_mux);
